column1: # Cross-check map: catalog model name → rows of the AWS Price List bulk files (public, no credentials).
# The portal's daily price update takes prices from LiteLLM's price list and compares them with these rows,
# in each model's region (catalog/models.tsv column 5, else AWS_REGION_NAME). A gap of more than 2% is shown
# as a warning on Home and in ./stack costs; nothing here ever changes a price.
# offer:     AmazonBedrock (third-party and Amazon models; units "1K tokens")
#            AmazonBedrockFoundationModels (Marketplace models: Anthropic, Cohere, Stability; units "1M tokens")
# provider:  the product's "provider" attribute ("-" = do not check)
# model:     the product's "model" attribute (Amazon Titan products: "titanModel")
# usagetype: the product's usagetype without its region prefix ("USE1-", "USE1-MP:USE1_") and "-Units" suffix.
#            In-region "*_standard" is the price of the `us.` (Geo) inference profiles the catalog uses.
# A model with field "-" has no rows in the AWS feed: its cross-check is "n/a".
